tools.name: get_festival_dates
tools.description:
Hindu festivals, vrats and observances between two dates, soonest first, from DharmikVibes' verified
    festival calendar, including multi-day festivals such as Navratri with their end date. A date is given
    only when it has been checked against an independent official or temple source; festivals still being
    checked are listed separately with no date.

from_date.description: ISO start date, for example 2026-10-01. Omit for today in India.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: ISO end date. Omit for 45 days after the start; at most 400 days.
to_date.title: To Date

days.description: Instead of to_date: how many days after the start, 1 to 400.
days.title: Days

tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description:
Panchang for one day in one city: sunrise, sunset, moonrise and moonset there, and the tithi
    (with paksha), nakshatra, yoga and karana prevailing at that sunrise, each with the time it ends,
    plus any festival on DharmikVibes' verified calendar that day. Always states the city, time zone
    and date used. If no city is given and no approximate location is available, it asks for one.

city.description: The city to compute for, from the fixed list. Omit to use the person's approximate location when the app provides it.
city.title: City

date.description: ISO date, for example 2026-12-25. Omit for today in that city.
date.title: Date

tools.name: get_vrat_guide
tools.description:
Which vrats (fasts) fall on which dates: Ekadashi, Pradosh, Purnima, Amavasya, Karwa Chauth and
    others, with the deity, from DharmikVibes' verified festival calendar and DivineAI's vrat list. How a
    vrat is kept is included only once a scholar has checked that text.

vrat.description: Only this vrat, for example Ekadashi, Pradosh, Karwa Chauth, Purnima. Omit for all.
vrat.title: Vrat

from_date.description: ISO start date. Omit for today in India.
from_date.title: From Date

to_date.description: ISO end date. Omit for 60 days after the start.
to_date.title: To Date

include_weekly.description: Also list the weekday vrats (Somvar, Mangalvar, ...).
include_weekly.title: Include Weekly

tools.name: search_pujas
tools.description:
DharmikVibes' bookable pujas that are listed right now: title, temple, place, open dates, time slots,
    languages, and the dharmikvibes.com page where it is booked. The price appears only as listed on the
    website; this tool never works one out. It books nothing.

query.description: Words from the puja name, temple or place, in English or Hindi, for example Vindhyachal, Bhairav, Kashi.
query.title: Query

on_or_after.description: ISO date. Only pujas with an open date on or after it.
on_or_after.title: On Or After

tools.name: search_darshan
tools.description:
Temples DharmikVibes lists for darshan and puja: place, facilities, the temple's own listed hours and the
    pujas currently bookable there. Darshan timings are not verified by DharmikVibes; check with the temple.
    VIP darshan is arranged by the DharmikVibes team on request. It books nothing.

query.description: Temple name or place, for example Tirupati, Vindhyachal.
query.title: Query
